Look, this whole soft generation thing has gone too far. We all must learn to suffer. Everyone needs to embrace the pain like Goggins says, no exceptions. If you're not destroying yourself in training you're not training, period. Comfort is the enemy. Pleasure is the enemy. Anyone who says otherwise is lying to themselves and to you. I do hour long ice baths now and I haven't slept properly in three weeks because I push through every workout until I literally can't stand. That's the only way. Pain is the teacher. Pain is the master. Anyone telling you to listen to your body is selling you something. Real growth requires that you become someone who can endure absolutely anything no matter the cost. We must all toughen up. The world rewards only those who refuse to quit, no matter what their body or their mind tells them. If it's not breaking you it's not building you. End of story.
